correctness.rationale: The 8/7 orbit exact Markov equations give the displayed difference by rational matrix elimination; independently constructed 14-state rational solutions agree for 17 selected pairs. With positive fecundities all mixed states are transient. B(u,v) has strictly positive coefficients for u,v>0; Descartes gives exactly one positive root in h for each l>0; a second Descartes argument on the diagonal cubic gives its one positive bifurcation l_c. Together these establish all strict signs/equality cases over the full positive domain. Standalone exact verifier passes 77 assertions; finite examples are not treated as universal proof.

value.rationale: A four-cycle with two equal-quality-site counts is the smallest ring where the same resource multiset can be arranged in two structurally different ways. The exact one-switch phase diagram decides which arrangement maximizes full fixation probability at every positive mutant-only two-fitness contrast, and proves that neither universal clustering nor universal alternation is correct. This is a complete natural minimal classification, with a motivated boundary distinguishing finite-site spatial correlation from prior shared-background cases; there is no claim of field-scale applicability.
